notes: This contract pins the official C++ surfaces used by the bounded changed-lookahead re-enable slice for an explicit-source regional timestamped Update Attribute Values passel. A producer queues one update while regulating with lookahead one, disables and re-enables regulation at lookahead three, verifies Query Lookahead, and advances to establish the new GALT boundary before a regional Reflect Attribute Values and Time Advance Grant callback. The queued passel, source-region metadata, callback ordering, and retraction classification are preserved. This is development-profile evidence only; it does not claim remote transport, save/restore, package/JUnit/protected-review evidence, validation, interoperability, or conformance.
